description:
[FREE] TGOV - Treasury Governance Coordination for multi-agent
capital deployment. Takes a fleet of agents each requesting to deploy
treasury capital (risk tier 1-5, mandate cap, requested amount), the
current market state (volatility percentage), and an optional set of
governance rules; returns the coordinated deployment decision for
every agent plus a full audit log. Rules fire on threshold crossings
(volatility above 15 caps high-risk tiers at 50 percent, above 30
pauses them, above 60 freezes all - default pack). Verdicts: CLEAR,
ADJUSTED, PAUSED, FREEZE (worst case wins). This tool returns service
info and terms. The paid decision endpoint is
https://agentpaystore.com/tgov/api/coordinate (POST, $0.05 USDC via
x402 on Base L2, HTTP 402 without X-Payment).
